purpose: Test actor by actor whether a proved notice or information state preceded a later act or omission, without treating chronology, professional association, corporate succession or adverse outcome as proof of knowledge, coordination, intent or criminal liability.
legal_architecture: Notice must be tied to a dated source and the correct legal person/capacity.
Later conduct must be independently identified; silence or omission requires a proved duty and ability to act.
Contribution, causation and benefit are separate questions.
An innocent or lawful explanation must be recorded beside the allegation.
Potential civil, insolvency, professional-discipline, procedural or criminal relevance is conditional on the elements and law applicable to the relevant date.
